hypothesis: Test whether the mechanical oneil-cup-handle interpretation improves month-level outcomes over the same-stock buy-and-hold control.

trader_attribution.name: William Oneil
trader_attribution.rule_interpretation: Base depth 15-35% with final handle no deeper than 15%; close above handle high on at least 1.4x volume; exit below SMA20. Mechanical proxy of the published pattern.

parameter_rationale: Two preregistered lookbacks bracket the published/default horizon; this is a bounded first grid, not a claim that all possible settings were searched.
baseline: One 25% long buy-and-hold position on the same stock and timeframe, filled next open
signal_rule: Base depth 15-35% with final handle no deeper than 15%; close above handle high on at least 1.4x volume; exit below SMA20. Mechanical proxy of the published pattern. All signals use completed bars and next-open fills; no current incomplete higher-timeframe bar.
cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
selection: Research ranking only; no automatic trading approval
limitations: Author's discretionary choices are not reproduced
